name: Infection stacks only on a bleeding auto-attack target (#2323)
contract: Infection 704624 reads 'Auto attacking a bleeding target will now infect the wound, increasing their chance to be critically struck from you by $707867s1% for $707867d, stacking $707867u times'. Its single effect is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Infection 707867 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_CHANCE_FOR_CASTER, BasePoints 0 -> +1% per stack, StackAmount 10, duration index 32, TargetA 6). Spell.dbc gives 704624 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and nothing was ever infected. The 'bleeding' half of the tooltip has no spell_proc column and is enforced by the CheckProc handler aura_ascension_bloodmage_infection, so the scenario needs both sides: Taldaram's Torment 800772 applies a periodic-damage effect with Mechanic 15 (MECHANIC_BLEED) to one creature, and a second creature is left unbled. 704624 has Stances 0x8000000 but also SPELL_ATTR2_ALLOW_WHILE_NOT_SHAPESHIFTED, so the passive applies outside any form. Note 707867's own text says 2% where its BasePoints give 1%; the DBC value is what is asserted.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Infection passive is active
SETUP: the first creature is bleeding
DISCRIMINATING: auto attacks infect the bleeding target
Infection grants the DBC value of +1% crit taken per stack
Swing at the unbled creature for several auto attacks
DISCRIMINATING: an unbled target is never infected
